what: Plan initializes phase2_relaunch_count next to fallback_count=0 at line 520, after the grouped phase-2 loop that must increment it
scenario_or_breakage: Grouped loop (479-515) runs first; a zero assignment at 520 wipes increments (or set -u aborts on first increment if the variable was never declared), so PHASE2_RELAUNCH_COUNT stays 0, combined_fallback equals fallback_count only, and the new threshold/cp-fail tests fail
suggested_fix: Initialize phase2_relaunch_count=0 once before the phase2_grouped loop (~479); increment only in the reuse_slot_result fall-through branch; never reset it alongside fallback_count=0
